summary:
On Dec. 18, 2020, with Christmas a week away and Donald Trump preparing to leave the White House, Steven Mnuchin's Treasury Department announced a plan that would require crypto exchanges and other financial institutions to collect more information about transactions involving wallets people controlled themselves. The public was given just 15 days to comment, with…
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: In late December 2020, Donald Trump's Treasury Department, led by Steven Mnuchin, proposed a rule requiring financial institutions and crypto exchanges to collect additional information on self-hosted wallet transactions. The proposal offered the public a brief 15-day comment period during the holiday season before ultimately being buried by the administration.
content_ta: டிசம்பர் 2020 இன் இறுதியில், Donald Trump இன் Treasury Department, Steven Mnuchin தலைமையில், சுய-ஹோஸ்ட் செய்யப்பட்ட வாலட் பரிவர்த்தனைகள் குறித்த கூடுதல் தகவல்களை நிதி நிறுவனங்களும் crypto exchanges-களும் சேகரிக்க வேண்டும் என்ற விதியை முன்மொழிந்தது. இந்தத் திட்டத்திற்கு விடுமுறை காலத்தில் வெறும் 15 நாட்கள் மட்டுமே பொதுமக்களின் கருத்துக்காக வழங்கப்பட்டது, பின்னர் அது நிர்வாகத்தால் கைவிடப்பட்டது.

title: Ripple and XRP Weekly Wrap: Institutional Wins, Nasdaq Debut, and Price Struggles

content: The past week brought a stark contrast for Ripple and its native cryptocurrency, XRP. While the ecosystem celebrated institutional victories and a notable Nasdaq debut, the digital asset continued to face persistent price struggles in the market. This mix of regulatory and market milestones highlights the ongoing challenges and growth of the platform.
content_ta: கடந்த வாரம் Ripple மற்றும் அதன் சொந்த cryptocurrency-ஆன XRP-க்கு ஒரு குறிப்பிடத்தக்க முரண்பாட்டை வழங்கியது. இந்த சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பு நிறுவன வெற்றிகளையும் ஒரு குறிப்பிடத்தக்க Nasdaq அறிமுகத்தையும் கொண்டாடிய அதேவேளையில், இந்த digital asset சந்தையில் தொடர்ந்து விலைச் சரிவுகளை எதிர்கொண்டது. இந்த ஒழுங்குமுறை மற்றும் சந்தை மைல்கற்களின் கலவையானது தளத்தின் நடந்துவரும் சவால்களையும் வளர்ச்சியையும் எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

content: Ripple's head of engineering has responded to a significant artificial intelligence breakthrough that successfully resolved a 25-year-old cryptography mystery. This development has sparked renewed discussions regarding longstanding concerns about potential security vulnerabilities and NSA backdoors, highlighting the growing intersection between advanced artificial intelligence and cryptographic security.
content_ta: Ripple நிறுவனத்தின் இன்ஜினியரிங் தலைவர், 25 ஆண்டுகள் பழமையான கிரிப்டோகிராஃபி மர்மத்தை வெற்றிகரமாகத் தீர்த்த செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு துறையின் முக்கிய சாதனைக்கு தனது கருத்தைத் தெரிவித்துள்ளார். இந்த முன்னேற்றம், சாத்தியமான பாதுகாப்பு குறைபாடுகள் மற்றும் NSA பேக்டோர்ஸ் குறித்த நீண்டகால கவலைகள் பற்றிய புதிய விவாதங்களைத் தூண்டியுள்ளது.

title: SOXL liquidations lead $52M chip-stock wipeout in 10 minutes while Wall Street was closed
summary:
Off-hours trading volatility highlights risks of leveraged positions, potentially deterring investors from perpetual contracts in semiconductor assets.
The post SOXL liquidations lead $52M chip-stock wipeout in 10 minutes while Wall Street was closed appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A sudden drop during off-hours trading led to massive liquidations involving SOXL, wiping out millions in chip-stock value within a brief ten-minute window while Wall Street was closed. This rapid volatility highlights the severe risks associated with leveraged trading positions in semiconductor assets, potentially causing investors to reconsider using perpetual contracts for these high-risk financial instruments.
content_ta: Wall Street விடுமுறை நாட்களில், ஆஃப்டர் ஹவர்ஸ் வர்த்தகத்தின் போது ஏற்பட்ட திடீர் சரிவு SOXL தொடர்பான பெரிய அளவிலான லிகிடேஷன்களுக்கு வழிவகுத்தது. இதனால் வெறும் பத்து நிமிடங்களில் சிப்-ஸ்டாக் மதிப்பு லட்சக்கணக்கில் சரிந்தது. இந்த திடீர் விலை変動மானது செமிகண்டக்டர் சொத்துக்களில் லெவரேஜ் செய்யப்பட்ட வர்த்தக நிலைகளின் அபாயங்களை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது, இது முதலீட்டாளர்களை மறுபரிசீலனை செய்யத் தூண்டலாம்.

summary:

content_ta: Anthropic நிறுவனத்தின் ஊழியர்கள் 2030-க்குள் தங்கள் பணியில் 75 சதவிகிதத்தை செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு (AI) கையாளுExpected செய்கிறது என்று எதிர்பார்க்கிறார்கள். இந்த எதிர்பார்ப்பு எதிர்கால பணிச்சூழலில் AI-யின் திறன்கள் குறித்தும், பொருளாதார திட்டமிடல் மற்றும் கொள்கை உருவாக்கத்தில் ஏற்படக்கூடிய மாற்றங்கள் குறித்தும் முக்கிய கேள்விகளை எழுப்புகிறது.

title: Chainalysis: Italy, Portugal and Singapore hold 66.9% of tokenized US Treasuries
summary:
The dominance of foreign holders in tokenized US Treasuries highlights shifting global investment dynamics and potential impacts on US financial influence.
The post Chainalysis: Italy, Portugal and Singapore hold 66.9% of tokenized US Treasuries appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A recent Chainalysis report reveals that Italy, Portugal, and Singapore together hold 66.9% of tokenized US Treasuries. This significant concentration among foreign investors highlights changing global investment trends and raises questions about potential future impacts on US financial influence, as digital asset adoption grows across international markets.
content_ta: Chainalysis வெளியிட்ட புதிய அறிக்கையின்படி, Italy, Portugal மற்றும் Singapore ஆகிய நாடுகள் இணைந்து tokenized US Treasuries-ல் 66.9 சதவீதத்தை வைத்துள்ளன. வெளிநாட்டு முதலீட்டாளர்களின் இந்த ஆதிக்கம் உலகளாவிய முதலீட்டுப் போக்குகளில் மாற்றங்களை ஏற்படுத்துவதோடு, அமெரிக்க நிதிச் செல்வாக்கிலும் தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும்.

content: Anthropic has experienced significant growth, tripling in size while its junior technical headcount dropped to 14%. This shift highlights a changing landscape for entry-level technology positions as the company scales. The development points toward broader trends in how modern tech firms are structuring their workforces amidst rapid expansion and automation.
content_ta: Anthropic நிறுவனம் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க வளர்ச்சியைப் பெற்றுள்ள நிலையில், ஜூனியர் டெக்னிக்கல் பணியாளர்களின் எண்ணிக்கை 14 சதவீதமாகக் குறைந்துள்ளது. நிறுவனம் மிகப்பெரிய அளவில் விரிவடைந்து வரும் சூழலில், ஆரம்ப நிலை தொழில்நுட்பப் பணியிடங்களுக்கான வேலைவாய்ப்பு நிலவரம் மாறிவருவதை இந்த மாற்றம் காட்டுகிறது.

title: Scammer Loses $4,800,000 in Bitcoin as Thieves Drain Ledger Wallets Holding ‘Task Scam’ Proceeds
summary:
Chainalysis reports that a crypto scammer lost over 60 BTC worth about $4.8 million when thieves emptied three Ledger hardware wallet addresses holding task scam proceeds.
The post Scammer Loses $4,800,000 in Bitcoin as Thieves Drain Ledger Wallets Holding ‘Task Scam’ Proceeds appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis reports that a cryptocurrency scammer lost approximately 4.8 million dollars in Bitcoin when thieves emptied three Ledger hardware wallet addresses. The stolen funds were reportedly the proceeds of a previous task scam. The incident highlights ongoing security risks involving crypto storage devices and illicit activities.
content_ta: பிளாக்செயின் பகுப்பாய்வு நிறுவனமான Chainalysis வெளியிட்ட அறிக்கையின்படி, ஒரு கிரிப்டோ மோசடி செய்பவரின் Ledger ஹார்டுவேர் வாலட்களில் இருந்த சுமார் 4.8 மில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்பிலான Bitcoin திருடப்பட்டுள்ளது. திருடப்பட்ட இந்த நிதியானது முந்தைய டாஸ்க் மோசடி மூலம் பெறப்பட்டவை என்று தெரிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Poland and China Lead Central Bank Gold Buying Surge in 2026
summary:
Central banks collectively hold nearly 37,000 tonnes of gold, with Poland and China the year's biggest accumulators, per World Gold Council data.
The post Poland and China Lead Central Bank Gold Buying Surge in 2026 appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: According to World Gold Council data, central banks collectively hold nearly 37,000 tonnes of gold. Poland and China have emerged as the largest accumulators in this ongoing buying surge, driving significant growth in official gold reserves globally.
content_ta: World Gold Council தரவுகளின்படி, மத்திய வங்கிகள் கூட்டாக கிட்டத்தட்ட 37,000 டன் தங்கத்தை வைத்துள்ளன. இந்த வாங்கும் எழுச்சியில் Poland மற்றும் China ஆகியவை இந்த ஆண்டின் மிகப்பெரிய சேமிப்பாளர்களாக உருவெடுத்துள்ளன.

title: BTC, ETH, XRP Recover From a Flash Crash as More Volatility Looms: Weekend Watch
summary: Calls for a "Black Monday" are going viral online, so is this the calm before the major storm?
content: Major cryptocurrencies including BTC, ETH, and XRP have managed to recover following a sudden flash crash. However, market analysts warn that further volatility could still lie ahead as the weekend approaches. Meanwhile, viral online rumors predicting a severe market crash known as a Black Monday are circulating, leaving investors wondering if this recent recovery is merely the calm before a much larger storm.
content_ta: BTC, ETH மற்றும் XRP உள்ளிட்ட முக்கிய கிராப்டோகரன்சிகள் திடீர் வீழ்ச்சிக்குப் பிறகு மீண்டு வந்துள்ளன. இருப்பினும், வார இறுதி நெருங்கி வருவதால் மேலும் சந்தை ஏற்ற இறக்கங்கள் இருக்கக்கூடும் என்று நிபுணர்கள் எச்சரிக்கின்றனர். இதற்கிடையில், பிளாக் மண்டே எனப்படும் பெரும் சந்தை வீழ்ச்சி பற்றிய வاகையங்கள் இணையத்தில் பரவி வருவது முதலீட்டாளர்கள் மத்தியில் சந்தேகத்தை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Crypto funds shed $434M as CoinShares flags ‘clear deterioration in sentiment’
summary: Institutions sold more ETH than any crypto asset as anticipated Q4 rally remains elusive.
content: Digital asset investment funds experienced significant outflows, shedding $434 million amid a noticeable downturn in market sentiment. According to CoinShares, institutional investors offloaded more Ethereum than any other cryptocurrency. This widespread selling pressure comes as an anticipated fourth-quarter market rally fails to materialize, leaving investors cautious as broader market conditions remain uncertain.
content_ta: டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து முதலீட்டு நிதிகள் கணிசமான அளவில் வெளியேற்றங்களைச் சந்தித்தன, சந்தை உணர்வில் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க சரிவு ஏற்பட்டதால் $434 மில்லியன் இழப்பைச் சந்தித்தன. CoinShares-ன் கூற்றுப்படி, நிறுவன முதலீட்டாளர்கள் மற்ற எந்த கிரிப்டோகரன்சியை விடவும் அதிக அளவில் Ethereum-ஐ விற்றுள்ளனர். பரவலான நான்காம் காலாண்டு சந்தை உயர்வு ஏற்படத் தவறியதால், இந்த விற்பனை அழுத்தம் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Microsoft scraps UK data center deal with Nscale, putting IPO plans at risk
summary:
Nscale's IPO prospects dim as grid issues highlight infrastructure challenges, raising doubts about its ability to fulfill its backlog.

content: Microsoft has canceled its UK data center deal with Nscale. This decision creates challenges for Nscale, raising doubts about its infrastructure capabilities and placing its upcoming IPO plans at risk amid growing grid and energy issues.
content_ta: Microsoft நிறுவனம் Nscale உடனான தனது UK டேட்டா சென்டர் ஒப்பந்தத்தை ரத்து செய்துள்ளது. இந்த முடிவு Nscale நிறுவனத்திற்கு புதிய சவால்களை உருவாக்கியுள்ளதுடன், அதன் உள்கட்டமைப்பு திறன்கள் குறித்த சந்தேகங்களை எழுப்பி, அதன் வரவிருக்கும் IPO திட்டங்களையும் ஆபத்தில் ஆழ்த்தியுள்ளது.

content: Crypto figure Justin Sun has reportedly sold the majority of his ETH holdings and shifted capital into US stocks. content_ta: கிரிப்டோ துறையைச் சேர்ந்த Justin Sun தனது பெரும்பான்மையான ETH பங்குகளை விற்றுவிட்டு, US stocks-ல் முதலீடு செய்துள்ளதாக தகவல்கள் வெளியாகியுள்ளன. இந்த மூலோபாய மாற்றம் பாரம்பரிய பங்குகளுக்கு மாறியுள்ளதை வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது, இது சந்தை பார்வையாளர்களின் கவனத்தை ஈர்த்துள்ளது.

title: Crypto exchanges Binance, Coinbase join West Africa scam sweep that flagged $11 million
summary: Private-sector partners flagged $11 million in funds that could be frozen, while officials reported cryptocurrency seizures without disclosing their value.
content: Major cryptocurrency exchanges Binance and Coinbase participated in a West Africa scam sweep that successfully flagged $11 million in potentially fraudulent funds. Private-sector partners helped identify these assets for freezing, while law enforcement officials reported seizing various cryptocurrencies during the operation without publicly disclosing their exact monetary value.
content_ta: West Africa பகுதியில் நடைபெற்ற மோசடி வேட்டையில் முக்கிய cryptocurrency exchanges ஆன Binance மற்றும் Coinbase ஆகியவை பங்கேற்றுள்ளன. இதன் மூலம் $11 million மதிப்பிலான முறைகேடான நிதி முடக்கத்திற்காக கண்டறியப்பட்டது. தனியார் துறை கூட்டாளர்களின் உதவியுடன் இந்த சொத்துக்கள் அடையாளம் காணப்பட்ட நிலையில், அதிகாரிகள் சில cryptocurrencies-ஐயும் பறிமுதல் செய்தனர்.

title: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
summary:
The incident highlights the critical need for robust security in crypto bridges, affecting token value and user trust in cross-chain systems.

content: Cysic has halted its crypto bridge following an unauthorized mint of 10 million CYS tokens. title: Bitcoin Futures Open Interest Slips To $7.68 Billion As Traders Keep Funding Positive
summary: TL;DR: A Saturday derivatives snapshot showed Bitcoin open interest at $7.68 billion, down 0.69% in 24 hours. Funding remained positive, but the data does not establish that traders have finished reducing leverage. Bitcoin‘s derivatives market is heading through the weekend with slightly less leverage outstanding, though not with an outright bearish positioning signal. A market snapshot at 11:00 UTC on Saturday, October 17, put Bitcoin futures open interest at $7.68 billion, a 0.69% decline over 24 hours. The same survey recorded a positive funding rate of 0.0035% per eight-hour interval, meaning long positions were paying shorts on the perpetual contracts represented in the sample. Those two readings describe different things. Falling open interest means contracts are being closed or reduced; positive funding indicates a continued willingness among leveraged buyers to pay for exposure. Neither statistic, by itself, predicts Bitcoin’s next price move. Bitcoin’s long-account share was 63.2% in the surveyed market data. That is a measure of accounts, not a claim that nearly two-thirds of all capital or contracts sat on the long side. Every derivatives contract necessarily has a buyer and seller, which is why that distinction matters. There was also a wider reduction in risk across the market. Solana open interest fell 4.25% to about $929.5 million during the same observation period, a considerably larger percentage decline than Bitcoin’s. Weekend liquidity can make short-lived moves more dramatic, but the snapshot offers no basis for assuming a liquidation event is over or that any particular support price will hold. Traders will get a clearer read when normal weekday volumes return.

title: Ethereum ETFs Lose $320 Million In A Week As Bitcoin Outflows Slow
summary: TL;DR: US spot Ethereum ETFs lost $320.1 million in the week ending October 16, more than the $228.4 million withdrawn from Bitcoin funds. BlackRock’s ETHA accounted for nearly all of the Ether redemptions. Ethereum investment funds have ended another difficult week on the wrong side of the ledger. US spot Ether ETFs recorded $320.1 million in net withdrawals between October 12 and 16, while comparable Bitcoin products lost $228.4 million, according to Farside Investors. The difference is striking, but it needs some context. Ether funds were not suffering their worst week on record. They lost roughly $542 million in the preceding five sessions. What changed most visibly this week was the pace of Bitcoin redemptions, which slowed enough to put Ethereum ahead in the outflow rankings. BlackRock’s iShares Ethereum Trust, ETHA, did most of the damage. Its five-day net loss was approximately $299 million, almost 93% of the total across US spot Ether funds. Monday started with an $85.4 million industry-wide withdrawal; a $24.8 million inflow on Tuesday offered a brief reprieve, before selling returned on Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. Fidelity’s FETH managed modest positive flows during the week, underlining that investors were not treating every issuer alike. ETF flow figures reflect creations and redemptions of fund shares, not a direct measure of all demand for ETH. Still, the concentration of withdrawals in the market’s largest Ether product raises an uncomfortable question: if institutional appetite returns, will it return to Ethereum as quickly as it does to Bitcoin?

title: Robinhood Chain Now Accounts For More Than Half Of Uniswap Revenue
summary: TL;DR: Uniswap generated approximately $14.81 million in protocol revenue during September, with Robinhood Chain contributing about 53% of the total. Tokenized-stock trading is changing where the exchange earns its fees. Uniswap’s strongest reported revenue month has come from an unexpected direction: a relatively new network associated with a mainstream brokerage. September protocol revenue reached approximately $14.81 million, according to figures discussed by Token Terminal and reported on October 17. Robinhood Chain, which launched in July, accounted for roughly 53% of that amount. That works out to nearly $7.9 million from one network alone. For a decentralized exchange better known for swapping crypto tokens, the source of the growth matters as much as the total. Tokenized stocks and other on-chain representations of traditional assets have created an additional pool of transactions from which trading fees can be earned. That does not mean traditional finance has simply moved onto Uniswap. Products differ in their legal rights, issuer structures and geographic restrictions, and some stock-linked tokens are not equivalent to holding the underlying shares directly. But revenue generated from these instruments is real economic activity for the trading protocol. It also creates a concentration question. If more than half of one month’s revenue comes from a single network, changes in that network’s trading incentives, competition or activity could move Uniswap’s results sharply in either direction. The September figures illustrate an important change in the business of decentralized exchanges. Crypto-to-crypto speculation is no longer the only activity capable of generating material protocol fees. Whether the new revenue mix lasts will depend on recurring trading demand, not one standout month.
content: Uniswap generated significant protocol revenue in September, with the newly launched Robinhood Chain contributing over half of the total amount. This growth highlights a shift toward tokenized-stock trading and on-chain representations of traditional assets, creating new fee streams for the decentralized exchange alongside traditional cryptocurrency swaps.

title: Aave’s Native Bitcoin Plan Moves Forward, But Governance Has Questions
summary: TL;DR: Babylon Labs has advanced a proposal to bring native Bitcoin collateral to Aave V4 without requiring wrapped BTC or a central custodian. The plan still faces community review, risk analysis and governance votes. Bitcoin could become collateral for Aave loans without first being handed to a custodian or converted into a freely traded wrapped token. That is the proposal Babylon Labs took to Aave’s governance forum on October 14, advancing a project that has been under discussion since an earlier temperature check. The design uses Trustless Bitcoin Vaults. A user locks BTC into a Taproot-based arrangement on the Bitcoin network, while Aave V4 records restricted collateral units inside a dedicated lending market. Those accounting units are not intended to circulate like ordinary wrapped Bitcoin. The attraction is clear: holders could borrow stablecoins against their BTC while the underlying coins remain governed by Bitcoin-side spending conditions. Aave’s proposed hub-and-spoke design is intended to isolate the market’s particular risks instead of mixing them with every other collateral asset. But it would be premature to call the integration approved. The current Aave Request for Comment is a governance stage, not a live borrowing product. Risk parameters, community support, a Snapshot vote and an eventual on-chain proposal remain ahead. Forum participants have already raised technical questions about emergency pauses and who controls parts of the vault infrastructure. Those details matter in lending, where the ability to release or liquidate collateral can become critical during market stress. For now, this is a serious attempt to connect Bitcoin liquidity with Ethereum-style lending, with the hardest operational questions still being worked through in public.
content: Babylon Labs has advanced a proposal to bring native Bitcoin collateral to Aave V4 using Trustless Bitcoin Vaults, avoiding wrapped tokens or central custodians. The plan allows users to lock BTC on the Bitcoin network and borrow against it while isolating risk in a dedicated lending market. The initiative is currently undergoing community review, risk analysis, and governance votes, with forum participants raising technical questions about emergency procedures.

title: Bitcoin’s Quantum Transition Won’t Stop at Bitcoin
summary: HONG KONG, October 18, 2026 – As quantum computing advances, the challenge extends beyond Bitcoin’s cryptography to the financial infrastructure built around it. Quantum computing is emerging as one of Bitcoin’s long-term security challenges. A sufficiently powerful quantum computer could theoretically compromise the digital signatures protecting Bitcoin transactions, potentially exposing funds associated with vulnerable public keys. While no publicly demonstrated quantum computer is currently capable of such an attack at scale, the implications extend beyond Bitcoin itself. As Bitcoin becomes increasingly integrated into decentralized finance (DeFi) through tokenized assets such as Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC), a future cryptographic transition would affect not only the Bitcoin network, but also the financial infrastructure built around it. The question is no longer simply whether Bitcoin can become quantum-resistant, but whether the broader ecosystem can evolve alongside it. Beyond the Bitcoin Network Bitcoin’s transition to quantum-resistant cryptography would require more than introducing new signature schemes. Wallets, exchanges, custodians and infrastructure providers would need to adapt their systems, potentially migrating existing BTC holdings to new security standards. Proposals such as BIP-360 reflect ongoing efforts to explore Bitcoin’s future cryptographic architecture. Yet coordinating adoption across a decentralized ecosystem could take years. For tokenized Bitcoin, the challenge becomes more complex. Even if Bitcoin adopts quantum-resistant cryptography, the custody systems, smart contracts and networks supporting tokenized assets would still require independent security assessments. Securing Bitcoin itself does not automatically secure everything built around it. WBTC and the Next Generation of Bitcoin Infrastructure As an established tokenized Bitcoin asset in DeFi, WBTC illustrates the scale and complexity of securing Bitcoin across multiple financial ecosystems. With 116,000 WBTC in circulation, representing approximately $9.5 billion in Bitcoin-backed assets, WBTC’s infrastructure supports Bitcoin liquidity across lending protocols, decentralized exchanges and multiple blockchain networks. Backed 1:1 by BTC held in custody, WBTC’s long-term resilience depends not only on Bitcoin’s underlying cryptography, but also on reserve security, custody operations and the infrastructure supporting minting and redemption. A future quantum-resistant transition could require custodians to evaluate their key-management systems, migrate underlying BTC reserves and maintain operational continuity throughout the process. Against this backdrop, WBTC is preparing to migrate to new Custodian Bitcoin Deposit Addresses (CBDAs) as part of its custody infrastructure management. Bitcoin address management is relevant to long-term security because public-key exposure can influence vulnerability to potential quantum attacks. However, the security implications depend on address types and transaction histories, and address migration alone does not establish quantum resistance. WBTC has also publicly announced its exploration of a multi-custodian reserve model, aimed at reducing custody concentration risk and strengthening operational resilience. While diversification does not directly address quantum vulnerabilities, it could provide greater flexibility as security standards evolve, depending on implementation. Together, these initiatives highlight the importance of both reserve security and operational resilience as Bitcoin’s financial ecosystem expands. Neither replaces the need for quantum-resistant cryptography, but both illustrate the infrastructure considerations involved in preparing for future changes. Preparing for the Next Era The timeline for quantum computing remains uncertain, but preparing for potential cryptographic changes is a long-term challenge for the entire Bitcoin ecosystem. For WBTC, this means considering how custody arrangements, reserve management and supporting blockchain infrastructure could evolve alongside Bitcoin’s security standards. Bitcoin’s quantum transition may begin with cryptography, but its success will depend on the resilience of the infrastructure connecting Bitcoin to the wider financial ecosystem. About WBTC – Bitcoin’s Passport to DEFI WBTC is the new Bitcoin standard. A singular identity for Bitcoin across multiple chains. It brings Bitcoin into environments where speed, capital efficiency, and scale are essential, while maintaining fidelity to Bitcoin’s original principles. There is no second. WBTC stands alone in its role, trusted, verifiable, and engineered for a multichain world. title: Tokenized Stocks Reach $262 Million In DeFi, But The Growth Is Not All On Base
summary: TL;DR: Stock-linked tokens deployed in DeFi reached an estimated $262.4 million across blockchains at the end of September, up nearly 18-fold from the start of 2026. The trade-off is exposure to protocol risks and liquidity conditions that do not exist in the same form in an ordinary brokerage account. It is also important not to assume that every token represents direct legal ownership of an underlying share. Rights, redemption mechanisms and eligibility rules vary by issuer. The $262 million figure is still small beside conventional equity markets. But its significance lies in what those assets are being used for: programmable financial activity, not simply a blockchain-branded way to hold a stock.

title: Block’s Proto Mining Hardware Gets A Smaller Entry Point With Sazmining
summary: TL;DR: Sazmining is offering individual Proto immersion hashboards at $4,187 each, with financing and managed hosting. Buying into industrial Bitcoin mining usually means dealing with noisy equipment, electricity contracts and cooling infrastructure. A new offering built around Block’s Proto hardware takes a different approach: purchase a single hashboard and leave the hosting to someone else. Sazmining lists Proto immersion hashboards configured for approximately 204 terahashes per second, with efficiency of roughly 15 joules per terahash. Three boards make up a full Proto Immersion Module, but customers can start with one. The advertised hardware price is $4,187. Its financing option requires $1,397 upfront followed by 18 monthly payments of $155, at a stated 0% interest rate. A separate hosting and maintenance fee of $153 a month applies, covering power at the quoted service rate and operational support. Those recurring charges are central to the economics. A lower entry price does not mean free mining, and the Bitcoin received depends on network difficulty, rewards, uptime, fees and the market price of BTC. A hashboard can be technically efficient and still produce disappointing returns for its owner. For Block, the offer broadens the potential audience for its Proto equipment. For Sazmining, it packages industrial hardware into a managed service that customers can purchase in smaller units. The appeal is convenience and modularity. The question for buyers is whether the projected mining revenue comfortably covers all the costs that continue after the hardware purchase.
content: Sazmining is offering individual Proto immersion hashboards from Jack Dorsey's Block at $4,187 each, featuring financing and managed hosting options. This arrangement lowers the upfront cost for retail buyers interested in Bitcoin mining.
